continuation.text:
I removed the Friday restriction from `src/solution.py`. I didn't run any checks.

I deleted the `FRIDAY_LATEST_START` constant and the `if day == "Fri"` block that capped the latest start at 15:00. Friday now follows the same rules as every other day, so the latest start is 17:00 minus the meeting duration.

I left everything else as it was. That includes the `day` parameter and the conversion of ISO dates to weekday names. `day` no longer affects the result, but I kept it so the function signature is unchanged.
